chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad and another, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muṣʿab, from Masʿadah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Abū Baṣīr said: I entered upon him, and with me was a boy guiding me, five years old, who had not reached puberty. So he said to me: How will you be when argument is made against you by one of the like of his age? Or he said: One of the like of his age will assume authority over you.

key_terms.احْتُجَّ: the proof or argument is established against you
key_terms.سَيَلِي: will assume authority or guardianship over you
key_terms.غُلَامٌ: a young boy accompanying Abū Baṣīr
key_terms.يَقُودُنِي: guiding me, indicating Abū Baṣīr was being led

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith from al-Kāfī address the Imamate of a young Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith presents Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام drawing attention to the possibility of divine authority and proof being manifested in one of very young age. Its significance lies in preparing the believers to accept the Imamate and religious authority of an Imam despite his young age.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, and someone else, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Mus’ab, from Mas’ada, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>.

Abu Baseer said, ‘I went over to him<sup>asws</sup> and with me was a boy, guiding me, being of five years old, not having attained adulthood. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘How would you be (reacting) when it is argued against you with the likes of his age?’ Or he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Or a successor<sup>asws</sup> upon you with the likes of his<sup>asws</sup> age?’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad and others have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid from Mus‘ab From Mas‘da from abu Basir who has said the following.

“Once I went to see him. Along with me there was a of five years old boy who had not yet attained puberty. The Imam (a.s.) said, “How would you feel if people will debate you about the divine authority of someone of his age? Or he said about the Divine authority of one who will come and will be of the same age as his.”
